mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_field (field_code, table_code, field_name, field_type, label, is_required, form_component, in_form, validate_rule, sort, is_enabled, business_code) VALUES (#{fieldCode}, #{tableCode}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldType}, #{label}, #{isRequired}, #{formComponent}, #{inForm, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{validateRule}, #{sort}, #{isEnabled, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{businessCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_field SET field_name = #{fieldName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, field_type = #{fieldType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, label = #{label, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_required = #{isRequired, jdbcType=INTEGER}, form_component = #{formComponent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, in_form = #{inForm, jdbcType=INTEGER}, validate_rule = #{validateRule, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sort = #{sort, jdbcType=INTEGER}, is_enabled = #{isEnabled, jdbcType=INTEGER}, business_code = #{businessCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM metadata_field WHERE id IN
#{id}

choose.when:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_field WHERE table_code = #{tableCode}
AND business_code = #{businessCode}
choose.otherwise:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_field f INNER JOIN metadata_table t ON f.table_code = t.table_code INNER JOIN metadata_business_system bs ON t.business_code = bs.business_code LEFT JOIN metadata_physical_database pdb ON ( NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.database_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(bs.database_name), ''))), '') IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(pdb.catalog_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.database_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(bs.database_name), '')))) ) WHERE f.table_code = #{tableCode} AND bs.is_enabled = 1 AND t.is_enabled = 1 AND f.is_enabled = 1 AND (pdb.id IS NULL OR pdb.is_enabled = 1)
AND f.business_code = #{businessCode}

mapper.select:
SELECT tc.constraint_name, CASE WHEN kcu.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLUMN' ELSE 'TABLE' END AS constraint_level FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema AND tc.table_name = kcu.table_name WHERE tc.table_schema =
#{tableSchema} DATABASE()
AND tc.table_name = #{tableName} AND tc.constraint_type = 'CHECK'

-- 查询常规约束 SELECT tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type, kcu.column_name, CASE WHEN kcu.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLUMN' ELSE 'TABLE' END AS constraint_level, CASE WHEN tc.constraint_type = 'CHECK' THEN cc.check_clause ELSE tc.constraint_name END AS constraint_content FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema AND tc.table_name = kcu.table_name LEFT JOIN information_schema.check_constraints cc ON tc.constraint_name = cc.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = cc.constraint_schema WHERE tc.table_schema =
#{tableSchema} DATABASE()
AND tc.table_name = #{tableName} UNION ALL -- 查询非空约束 SELECT CONCAT('NN_', c.column_name) AS constraint_name, 'NOT NULL' AS constraint_type, c.column_name, 'COLUMN' AS constraint_level, 'NOT NULL' AS constraint_content FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema =
#{tableSchema} DATABASE()
AND c.table_name = #{tableName} AND c.IS_NULLABLE = 'NO' AND c.COLUMN_KEY != 'PRI' -- 排除主键（主键自带非空约束）
